51360181.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to folded P-loop conformation of wild type N-terminal NH-tagged and avi-tagged dephosphorylated human c-MET (956 to 1390 residues) expressed in Sf21 cells by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. The wild-type human c-MET kinase domain (residues 956–1390) was expressed in Sf21 cells and purified as described previously. The protein was immobilized on the sensor chip via amine coupling. The binding of compounds to the immobilized c-MET was analyzed using a series of concentrations (0.1–100 μM) in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) at 25 °C. Association and dissociation phases were 120 and 180 s, respectively. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software to determine the dissociation constants (K_D).

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20)
